Name: Digital Era
Author: LanderZZ
Description:
📱 Digital Era - SMS System
Digital Era brings Pelican Town to the modern age in an organic and immersive way. Forget about letters that take days to arrive — now the villagers can interact with you in real time through a dynamic SMS messaging system that stays visually faithful to Stardew Valley's original aesthetic.
✨ Main Features
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Messaging[/b]: Receive texts based on your friendship level, the day of the month, and specific events.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla+ Aesthetic[/b]: The menu is designed to blend seamlessly with the game's interface, using official textures and colors.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Unlock System[/b]: Important NPCs like Mayor Lewis or Robin already have your number and can contact you from day one! Others will be unlocked as your friendship grows.[/*]
[*][b]Smooth Navigation[/b]: Optimized scrolling system for long contact lists and conversation histories.[/*]
[*][b]Discreet Notifications[/b]: HUD alerts (quest-style) that don't interrupt your gameplay.[/*]
[/list]🚀 How to Get Started
[list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b]: Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed.[/*]
[*][b]Download & Extract[/b]: Download the mod and extract the 
[code]Digital Era[/code] folder into your 
[code]Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*][b]Play[/b]: When you enter the game, you'll receive notifications as NPCs send you their first messages. Open your phone (configurable hotkey) to read and manage your contacts.[/*]
[/list]🌍 Languages
The mod comes with native support for:
[list]
[*][b]Portuguese (PT-BR)[/b]: Full content with over 2,000 lines of adapted dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]English (EN)[/b]: Full support for international players.[/*]
[/list][i](Note: We are open to community translations!)[/i]
🛠️ Requirements & Compatibility
[list]
[*][b]Version[/b]: Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][b]Compatibility[/b]: Works with most NPC mods (SVE, RSV). The system is optimized to avoid conflicts with the game's data loading.[/*]
[/list]
